identity.title: InfinityStar: Uniﬁed Spacetime AutoRegressive Modeling for Visual Generation

problem.claim: Develop a unified discrete autoregressive framework for high-resolution image and dynamic video synthesis, capturing spatial and temporal dependencies in one architecture.

contributions.claim: InfinityStar jointly models spatial and temporal dependencies through a purely discrete autoregressive architecture supporting text-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-video, and long-duration video generation.
The authors report strong VBench performance and substantially faster 5-second 720p video generation than leading diffusion-based methods without extra optimizations.
The authors release the code and models for further research in efficient, high-quality video generation.

stated_novelty.claim: The authors state that, to their knowledge, InfinityStar is the first discrete autoregressive video generator capable of producing industrial-level 720p videos.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The authors report an 83.74 VBench score, outperforming all autoregressive models by large margins and surpassing diffusion competitor HunyuanVideo.
The authors report approximately 10× faster generation of a 5-second, 720p video than leading diffusion-based methods, without extra optimizations.

narrative_sequence.summary: The paper introduces InfinityStar as a unified spacetime autoregressive framework for high-resolution images and dynamic video.
It uses purely discrete modeling to jointly capture spatial and temporal dependencies within one architecture.
The unified design is presented as supporting multiple image and video generation tasks, including long-duration synthesis through temporal autoregression.
The authors report strong VBench results and approximately 10× faster 5-second 720p generation than leading diffusion methods.
They state a first-of-its-kind 720p discrete autoregressive capability and release code and models.

source_observation.claim: The abstract connects one architectural choice—joint spatial-temporal discrete autoregression—to a broad task range and then reports both quality and speed outcomes.

lessons.interpretation: A compact abstract can make a system proposition legible by aligning design, supported use cases, and measurable outcomes.
lessons.application: When presenting a unified architecture, explicitly map its central mechanism to each claimed task and report outcome metrics that correspond to the intended benefits.
lessons.exception: This framing is unsuitable when tasks rely on materially different mechanisms or when the abstract lacks task-specific evidence.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify datasets, baselines, evaluation protocols, or the meaning of “industrial-level.”
The reported speed comparison does not state hardware, implementation details, or whether quality and generation settings were matched.
